local function spawnBunkerMeshes()
	local assets = game.ServerStorage:BGetChildren("BunkerAssets")
	
	if not assets then
		warn("BunkerAssets folder not found in ServerStorage!")
		return
	end
	
	local spawnedMeshes = {}
	
	for _, asset in ipairs(assets) do
		if asset:IsA("MeshPart") then
			local clone = asset:Clone()
			clone.Parent = game.Workspace
			table.insert(spawnedMeshes, clone)
		end
	end
	
	local startX = 0
	local startY = 5
	local spacing = 10
	
	for i, mesh in ipairs(spawnedMeshes) do
		local xPosition = startX + (i - 1) * spacing
		mesh.Position = Vector3.new(xPosition, startY, 0)
	end
	
	print("Bunker Assets successfully spawned!")
end

spawnBunkerMeshes()
